test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7568d85af3dd60f44e70facbdc3c979d492ac5224483ad0224b9d0fb586ff881.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/482dffbe6cf2575a6f96484b0bdd1e41f384e766d04cc0a77cfae86784d03521.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left, left-middle, top-middle and middle elements (all 4 elements) are interchanging their position in clockwise direction.

Top-right, bottom-right and bottom-middle element are interchanging their position with each other in an anticlockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Top-left, left-middle, and middle elements (all 3 elements) are interchanging their position in clockwise direction.

Top-right, top-middle, bottom-right, and bottom-middle element (all 4 elements) are interchanging their position with each other in a clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5dccc92edbd654107c0e10eef430ad955191d1c7b711f25b44f566a0a822029.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf4d26d94d88ba66e60c730d2e7bce54f5859abe835195c7031e2cf1b82f9956.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
